films.title: A Clockwork Orange
films.summary: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency. In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">A CLOCKWORK ORANGE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">STANLEY KUBRICK // 1971</text></svg>

films.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
films.summary: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">DAVID FINCHER // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Salò, or the 120 Days of Sodom
films.summary: Four corrupted fascist libertines round up 9 teenage boys and girls and subject them to 120 days of sadistic physical, mental and sexual torture.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SALÒ, OR THE 120 DAYS OF SODOM</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">PIER PAOLO PASOLINI // 1976</text></svg>

films.title: Possible Love
films.summary: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">POSSIBLE LOVE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">LEE CHANG-DONG // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Minotaur
films.summary: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MINOTAUR</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">ANDREI ZVYAGINTSEV // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Night at the Museum
films.summary: Chaos reigns at the natural history museum when night watchman Larry Daley accidentally stirs up an ancient curse, awakening Attila the Hun, an army of gladiators, a Tyrannosaurus rex and other exhibits.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NIGHT AT THE MUSEUM</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">SHAWN LEVY // 2006</text></svg>

films.title: Millennium Mambo
films.summary: In 2011, Vicky looks back on her life a decade earlier, recalling her turbulent relationship with her controlling boyfriend Hao Hao and her growing connection to a compassionate gangster amid the neon haze of Taipei's nightlife.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MILLENNIUM MAMBO</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">HOU HSIAO-HSIEN // 2001</text></svg>

films.title: The Manchurian Candidate
films.summary: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw, now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE MANCHURIAN CANDIDATE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">JONATHAN DEMME // 2004</text></svg>

films.title: The Conversation
films.summary: A paranoid, secretive surveillance expert has a crisis of conscience when he suspects that the couple he is spying on will be murdered.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE CONVERSATION</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FRANCIS FORD COPPOLA // 1974</text></svg>

films.title: The Devils
films.summary: In 1634 France, charismatic Father Urbain Grandier becomes the target of sexually depraved Sister Jeanne's accusations of witchcraft, which corrupt officials of church and state are all too happy to exploit.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE DEVILS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">KEN RUSSELL // 1971</text></svg>

films.title: Rashomon
films.summary: Four people recount different versions of the story of a man's murder and the rape of his wife.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">RASHOMON</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">AKIRA KUROSAWA // 1950</text></svg>

films.title: Sacrifice
films.summary: At a glitzy Greek island charity gala, a down-on-his-luck movie star lands the heroic role of a lifetime when a volcanic doomsday cult takes him hostage.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SACRIFICE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ROMAIN GAVRAS // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
films.summary: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">GODZILLA MINUS ZERO</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">TAKASHI YAMAZAKI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Mandy
films.summary: The Shadow Mountains, 1983. Red and Mandy lead a loving and peaceful existence; but when their pine-scented haven is savagely destroyed, Red is catapulted into a phantasmagoric journey filled with bloody vengeance and laced with fire.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MANDY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">PANOS COSMATOS // 2018</text></svg>

films.title: The Piano
films.summary: When an arranged marriage brings Ada and her spirited pre-teen daughter Flora to the wilderness of 19th-century New Zealand, she finds herself locked in a battle of wills with both her controlling husband and a rugged frontiersman to whom she develops a forbidden attraction.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE PIANO</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JANE CAMPION // 1993</text></svg>

films.title: The Holy Mountain
films.summary: The Alchemist assembles together a group of people from all walks of life to represent the planets in the solar system. The occult adept's intention is to put his recruits through strange mystical rites and divest them of their worldly baggage before embarking on a trip to Lotus Island. There they ascend the Holy Mountain to displace the immortal gods who secretly rule the universe.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE HOLY MOUNTAIN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ALEJANDRO JODOROWSKY // 1973</text></svg>

films.title: The Ascent
films.summary: During a freezing WWII winter, two Soviet partisans on a mission to gather food contend with the temperature, the occupying Germans, and their own psyches.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE ASCENT</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">LARISA SHEPITKO // 1977</text></svg>

films.title: Compartment No. 6
films.summary: A young Finnish woman escapes an enigmatic love affair in Moscow by boarding a train to the arctic port of Murmansk. Forced to share the long ride and a tiny sleeping car with a larger than life Russian miner, the unexpected encounter leads the occupants of Compartment No. 6 to face major truths about human connection.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">COMPARTMENT NO. 6</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JUHO KUOSMANEN // 2021</text></svg>

films.title: Primetime
films.summary: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PRIMETIME</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">LANCE OPPENHEIM // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: You Can See Everything
films.summary: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">NATHAN FIELDER // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Ebenezer
films.summary: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">EBENEZER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">TI WEST // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Hannah and Her Sisters
films.summary: Between two Thanksgivings, Hannah's husband falls in love with her sister Lee, while her hypochondriac ex-husband rekindles his relationship with her sister Holly.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HANNAH AND HER SISTERS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">WOODY ALLEN // 1986</text></svg>

films.title: NAZA
films.summary: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NAZA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">YUVAL ABRAHAM // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: All of a Sudden
films.summary: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ALL OF A SUDDEN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">RYUSUKE HAMAGUCHI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Eye for an Eye
films.summary: Anna, grieving the sudden death of her parents, relocates from New York to a small Florida town to live with the grandmother she has never met. Isolated, vulnerable, and in need of friends, she finds brief solace in the company of two local teens. But when she becomes complicit to their unforgivable act of violence, she finds herself ensnared by Mr. Sandman – the twisted soul of a tormented child who haunts bullies’ dreams before feasting on their eyeballs when they finally wake - Anna must right her wrong before becoming a victim of this gruesome curse.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">EYE FOR AN EYE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">COLIN TILLEY // 2025</text></svg>

films.title: Leonora in the Morning Light
films.summary: Leonora Carrington, an outstanding figure of surrealism, along with Frida Kahlo, was one of Mexico's most famous painters. As the long-time partner of Max Ernst and close friend of André Breton and Jean Miró, she continually struggles with her visionary imagination, which often triggers serious psychological crises.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">LEONORA IN THE MORNING LIGHT</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">THOR KLEIN // 2025</text></svg>

films.title: Paper Tiger
films.summary: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PAPER TIGER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JAMES GRAY // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Josephine
films.summary: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JOSEPHINE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BETH DE ARAÚJO // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Female Trouble
films.summary: Teenage delinquent Dawn Davenport, incensed after her parents do not give her the cha-cha heels she wanted for Christmas, runs away from home. After an illegitimate child and hairstylist husband bring her more misery, she's enticed into a life of crime when the owners of her husband's salon promise her fame and fortune.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FEMALE TROUBLE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">JOHN WATERS // 1976</text></svg>

films.title: Germany, Year Zero
films.summary: In the ruins of post-WWII Berlin, a twelve-year-old boy is left to his own devices in order to help provide for his family.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">GERMANY, YEAR ZERO</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">ROBERTO ROSSELLINI // 1948</text></svg>

films.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
films.summary: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PINOCCHIO: UNSTRUNG</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">RHYS FRAKE-WATERFIEL // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Fatherland
films.summary: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FATHERLAND</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">PAWEŁ PAWLIKOWSKI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Rome, Open City
films.summary: During the Nazi occupation of 1944 Rome, Resistance leader Giorgio Manfredi is pursued by the Nazis as he seeks refuge and a means of escape.

films.summary: Hobos encounter a sadistic railway conductor that will not let anyone "ride the rails" for free.

films.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
films.summary: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

films.title: Hexed
films.summary: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HEXED</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JASON HAND // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The History of Concrete
films.summary: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE HISTORY OF CONCRETE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JOHN WILSON // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Club Kid
films.summary: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CLUB KID</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JORDAN FIRSTMAN // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Tangles
films.summary: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TANGLES</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">LEAH NELSON // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Mouse
films.summary: In 2002 Arkansas, Callie and Minnie’s friendship is suddenly upended the summer before their senior year of high school. Left rudderless without her best friend, Minnie forms a complicated bond with Callie’s mother.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MOUSE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">KELLY O'SULLIVAN // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: I Play Rocky
films.summary: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">I PLAY ROCKY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PETER FARRELLY // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
films.summary: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in 1980s Los Angeles.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">EARTH GIRLS ARE EASY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JULIEN TEMPLE // 1988</text></svg>

films.title: Rate It X
films.summary: Rate It X is a bitingly funny and disarming journey through the landscape of American sexism. Men only are interviewed by the two filmmakers in a witty montage of free-wheeling encounters. Pornographers, corporate executives, a funeral parlor director and Santa Claus are among those who reveal more than they intended. A surprisingly candid view of men's feelings towards women 15 years after the birth of the women's movement.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">RATE IT X</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PAULA DE KOENIGSBERG // 1986</text></svg>

films.title: Wild Horse Nine
films.summary: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WILD HORSE NINE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">MARTIN MCDONAGH // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Rescuers
films.summary: Two agents of the mouse-run International Rescue Aid Society search for a little orphan girl kidnapped by sinister treasure hunters.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE RESCUERS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">WOLFGANG REITHERMAN // 1977</text></svg>

films.title: Elsinore
films.summary: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ELSINORE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">SIMON STONE // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: General Della Rovere
films.summary: In WWII-Italy, the Gestapo blackmails a con man to impersonate a dead partisan commander in order to extract information from his fellow inmates.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">GENERAL DELLA ROVERE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">ROBERTO ROSSELLINI // 1959</text></svg>

films.title: Where Is Freedom?
films.summary: A barber, murderer because of jealousy, spends twenty years in jail. He cannot, however adjust himself to a changed world and to the hypocrisy of his own relatives and decides to return behind bars.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WHERE IS FREEDOM?</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">ROBERTO ROSSELLINI // 1954</text></svg>

films.title: The Dirty Game
films.summary: A U.S. intelligence general recalls three Cold War cases of Soviet, French and Italian spies.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE DIRTY GAME</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">TERENCE YOUNG // 1965</text></svg>

films.title: Goodbye, Dragon Inn
films.summary: On a dark, wet night in Taipei City, a cavernous old picture palace is about to close its doors forever. A meager audience, the remaining few staff, and perhaps even a ghost or two, watch King Hu’s wuxia classic "Dragon Inn", each haunted by memories and desires evoked by cinema itself.

films.title: Dragon Superman
films.summary: Journalist San Lin-jun and his colleague attend a jewelry exhibition when the Cosmic Gang attacks, causing an explosion. A masked vigilante confronts the gang, leading to a battle between justice and evil.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DRAGON SUPERMAN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">SATORU KOBAYASHI // 1968</text></svg>

films.title: Focker In-Law
films.summary: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, father-in-law Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FOCKER IN-LAW</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JOHN HAMBURG // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
films.summary: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">DAVID GREAVES // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Columbus
films.summary: When a renowned architecture scholar falls suddenly ill during a speaking tour, his son Jin finds himself stranded in Columbus, Indiana - a small Midwestern city celebrated for its many significant modernist buildings. Jin strikes up a friendship with Casey, a young architecture enthusiast who works at the local library.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">COLUMBUS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">KOGONADA // 2017</text></svg>

films.title: Medea
films.summary: Based on the plot of Euripides' Medea. Medea centers on the barbarian protagonist as she finds her position in the Greek world threatened, and the revenge she takes against her husband Jason who has betrayed her for another woman.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MEDEA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">PIER PAOLO PASOLINI // 1969</text></svg>

films.title: 14th
films.summary: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">14TH</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">AVA DUVERNAY // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Railway Sleepers
films.summary: The first railway line in Thailand was inaugurated in 1893 – a sign of progress and prosperity. Shot over eight years on every active line of the country's railway system, this wondrous documentary offers an unprecedented immersion into the country's past and present.

films.title: Jineuleomi
films.summary: Playing at The Roxy Cinema.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JINEULEOMI</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">UNKNOWN // Classic</text></svg>

films.title: Another Day in Paradise
films.summary: In the hope of a big score, two junkie couples team up to commit various drug robberies which go disastrously wrong, leading to dissent, violence, and murder.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ANOTHER DAY IN PARADISE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">LARRY CLARK // 1998</text></svg>

films.title: Citizen Kane 85th Anniversary
films.summary: Playing at Nitehawk Cinema.

films.title: Ben'Imana
films.summary: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BEN'IMANA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">MARIE-CLÉMENTINE DUS // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Europa '51
films.summary: A wealthy, self-absorbed Rome socialite is racked by guilt over the death of her young son. As a way of dealing with her grief and finding meaning in her life, she decides to devote her time and money to the city’s poor and sick. Her newfound, single-minded activism leads to conflicts with her husband and questions about her sanity.

films.title: Barbara Forever
films.summary: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BARBARA FOREVER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">BRYDIE O'CONNOR // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Who Is Still Alive
films.summary: A map of Gaza, its towns, camps and neighbourhoods. White paint on a black ground. Within the crudely drawn outlines, nine refugees who escaped the inferno tell their stories.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WHO IS STILL ALIVE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">NICOLAS WADIMOFF // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Taxi Driver
films.summary: Suffering from insomnia, disturbed loner Travis Bickle takes a job as a New York City cabbie, haunting the streets nightly, growing increasingly detached from reality as he dreams of cleaning up the filthy city.

films.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
films.summary: As the railroad builders advance unstoppably through the Arizona desert on their way to the sea, Jill arrives in the small town of Flagstone with the intention of starting a new life.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ONCE UPON A TIME IN THE WEST</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">SERGIO LEONE // 1968</text></svg>

films.title: The Host
films.summary: A teenage girl is captured by a giant mutated squid-like creature that appears from Seoul's Han River after toxic waste was dumped in it, prompting her family into a frantic search for her.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE HOST</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BONG JOON HO // 2006</text></svg>

films.title: Mean Streets
films.summary: A small-time hood must choose from among love, friendship and the chance to rise within the mob.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MEAN STREETS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MARTIN SCORSESE // 1973</text></svg>

films.title: Memento
films.summary: Leonard Shelby is tracking down the man who raped and murdered his wife. The difficulty of locating his wife's killer, however, is compounded by the fact that he suffers from a rare, untreatable form of short-term memory loss. Although he can recall details of life before his accident, Leonard cannot remember what happened fifteen minutes ago, where he's going, or why.

films.title: Suspiria
films.summary: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.
